scope: Refuse generated PDF/DGN/DWF Underlay definitions and references when the requested DXF target revision predates the conservative per-kind compatibility floor.

behavior: The same per-kind target-version predicate gates both the typed definition and reference writers.
An unsupported version fails the strict output attempt before publication, retaining any existing destination.
After refusal, the same adapter and graph can retry at the first admitted target and complete typed readback.

documentedBoundaries.PDF: not supported before AutoCAD 2010, except with a Bonus Pack

versionEvidence.conservativeMapping: Project DRW::Version maps AC1021 to AutoCAD 2007/2008/2009. It cannot distinguish 2007 from 2008, so the writer requires AC1024 for DGN to avoid emitting it to an ambiguous AC1021 target. PDF also begins at AC1024. This is a conservative implementation boundary inferred from the product-release guidance and the repository version map; it is not a format support claim.

validationProfile.source: Locally generated in-memory Underlay graph with one definition and one reference per case; no DWG/DXF fixture is used or committed.
assertions: Each below-floor attempt fails and preserves a pre-existing destination sentinel.
Each corrected same-adapter retry writes successfully at the first admitted target.
Typed import checks one retained definition and one reference with the expected Underlay kind.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; six ASCII/Binary kind/version cells, atomic sentinel preservation, same-adapter retry, typed readback, plus existing graph/readback/wrong-kind/missing-target controls.
validation.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture was added or committed.

limitations: Generated transport evidence does not establish native PDF/DGN/DWF interpretation, physical producer coverage, or whole-document conversion.
The AC1024 DGN floor is conservative because AC1021 covers multiple product releases; it may reject a compatible 2008/2009 target encoded as AC1021.
No support claim is promoted; P8 remains open for native consumer, platform, ABI, packaging, and release qualification.
